title: laug · stack
description: What watching costs: each part up, its CPU, RSS and writes against the noise rule's R-e limits, the federation passes and what they cost each cell, the store's intake, disk, compactions and queries, the spans, follow and the host. The stack judges nothing; these are its own numbers. Times are UTC.

list.name: Every gate's wave
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_gate_step_seconds{step="wave"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (gate_id) last_over_time(laug_gate_step_seconds{step="wave end"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000

panels.title: The parts, and what each costs
Parts up (store)
panels.description: up of each of the stack's scrape jobs: cellstat, follow, the host (the Collector's exporter), the stack's own four, and the orchestrator's dev server, which is down between batches.

defaults.noValue: the store holds no up series

targets.legendFormat: the orchestrator's dev server (down between batches)

panels.title: CPU by part (% of one CPU), and summed against R-e's 5%
panels.description: cellstat -pids over the stack's records, every 5 s. Dashed ember: the noise rule's R-e, the stack's processes summed under 5% of one CPU through a wave (docs/CAPABILITIES.md, Observability).

panels.title: RSS by part, and summed against R-e's 1.5 GiB
panels.description: VmRSS of each part. Dashed ember: R-e's 1.5 GiB for the stack summed.

panels.title: Bytes written per 5 s, by part
panels.description: write_bytes from /proc of each part, per 5 s: a block write shows as one tall step.

panels.title: Federation: every leased cell kept, and what it costs the cell
Cells federated now (store)
panels.description: One row a federation target: its gate and item (absent for a hand lease), its cell and whether its last pass answered (up of job laug-cells).

panels.title: Cells federated, by gate and item (count)
panels.description: count of up of job laug-cells by gate and item: is every leased cell being kept.

defaults.noValue: no cell federated in this range

panels.title: A federation pass, per cell (s), against the 4 s timeout
panels.description: scrape_duration_seconds of each cell's /federate pass. Dashed ember: _obs/prometheus.yml's 4 s scrape timeout; a pass past it fails whole.

defaults.noValue: no cell federated in this range

panels.title: Samples a pass, per cell: S
panels.description: scrape_samples_scraped of each cell's pass: S, the series a cell holds of the 31 families and job sdk-workers.

defaults.noValue: no cell federated in this range

panels.title: The cell's side: each cell's prometheus container (cellstat, cores), against R-e's 0.05
panels.description: cgroup CPU of each cell's prometheus container: what federation costs the measured cell. Dashed ember: R-e's 0.05 cores; without federation it read 0.005 to 0.006 (cells/results/2026-10-17-lab-cell-usage.txt).

defaults.noValue: no cell container read by cellstat in this range

panels.title: The store: intake, disk, compactions and queries
Samples appended a second
panels.description: prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total over 2 m (the stack's own scrape is every 30 s).

panels.title: Series in the head
panels.description: prometheus_tsdb_head_series: what the store holds in memory.

panels.title: Compactions and their length
panels.description: increase of prometheus_tsdb_compactions_total over 2 m (count) and the mean compaction's seconds; shaded: every gate's wave, from its timeline. Did a compaction land inside a wave.

panels.title: The store on disk: blocks and WAL, against the 20 GB cap
panels.description: prometheus_tsdb_storage_blocks_bytes and prometheus_tsdb_wal_storage_size_bytes. Dashed ember: --storage.tsdb.retention.size 20GB, drawn as 20 GiB (Prometheus reads GB as 2^30 B: its runtime info gives 20GB as 20GiB); retention deletes blocks only.

panels.title: Free on OBS_DIR's filesystem, against the 30 GiB floor
panels.description: The Collector's filesystem scraper on OBS_DIR's mount, renamed obs on ingest. Dashed ember: bin/obs up refuses under 30 GiB free (OBS_MIN_FREE_GIB).

panels.title: Queries: Grafana's requests a second
panels.description: grafana_http_request_duration_seconds_count over 2 m: are people looking.

panels.title: Queries: the store's evaluation time, p90 (s)
panels.description: prometheus_engine_query_duration_seconds, the summary's 0.9 quantile of inner evaluation: what looking costs the store.

panels.title: Series kept since
panels.description: prometheus_tsdb_lowest_timestamp_seconds: the store's oldest sample. Retention is 90 d.

panels.title: Traces, follow, and the host
Spans since each part started: accepted, refused, failed and sent on (count)
panels.description: The Collector's own telemetry on 7753 and Jaeger's on 7763, both OpenTelemetry Collector counters (names as 0.162.0 and 2.21.0 serve them, seen): spans its OTLP receiver accepted, refused and failed, and spans its exporter sent on (the Collector to Jaeger; Jaeger to its Badger store). Accepted and sent on are equal when nothing is lost; a restart starts a part's counts at 0. otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans appears only once a send failed.

panels.title: follow: polls and failed laugd reads (per minute)
panels.description: laug_follow_polls_total (every 2 s, so about 30 a minute) and laugd_errors_total: three failed reads in a row drop every hand target.

panels.title: follow: targets, stale targets, gates found, files skipped (count)
panels.description: The target files it wrote, those past their lease's expiry (a dead follow's leftovers: bin/obs up restarts it), the gate directories it follows, and the files and lines it skipped since it started.

panels.title: The host: memory used and paging (the Collector)
panels.description: system_memory_usage_bytes used and the paging scraper's swap in use, every 15 s.

panels.title: The host: load average (the Collector)
panels.description: 1 m and 5 m load averages.

panels.title: The host: the root volume's operations (the Collector, ops/s)
panels.description: system_disk_operations_total of the root volume by direction, every 15 s, over 1 m.
